summary: PulseGuard v0.6.22 keeps automatic Windows Update maintenance from v0.6.21 and hardens ASUS driver routing, Defender security visibility, and large system-managed page-file reporting before wider rollout.

sections.heading: Normal Windows updates remain automatic inside FIX + OPTIMIZE ALL
sections.detail: PulseGuard uses the official Windows Update Agent to scan, download, and install eligible unattended Windows software updates as part of the one-click repair workflow. Preview/beta/Insider, major feature upgrades, firmware/BIOS/UEFI, browse-only optional, interactive, and EULA-gated updates remain deferred; restart is requested only when Windows or a driver update requires it.

sections.heading: ASUS exact-board support routing hardened
sections.detail: The dynamic driver engine now prefers ASUS's locale-qualified /us/supportonly/<board>/helpdesk_download route, validates exact board identity, rejects malformed /undefined/ or /null/ redirects, and keeps the verified requested support URL rather than publishing a broken redirect. Driver Engine version is now 0.2.4.

sections.heading: OEM discovery now fails closed with a truthful status
sections.detail: If an exact official OEM page is verified but the static response exposes no direct trusted ZIP/CAB package URLs, PulseGuard reports that condition explicitly and does not guess, scrape an untrusted executable, or claim a broken URL. Microsoft Update and exact-hardware-ID driver sources remain available.

sections.heading: Defender Tamper Protection is now visible
sections.detail: Full Health Scan adds an informational Security finding when Defender antivirus and real-time protection are active but Tamper Protection is off. Dashboard/sidebar details also surface the state. PulseGuard reports it but does not silently force the setting.

sections.heading: Large system-managed page files are explained, not treated as faults
sections.detail: When Windows automatic page-file management has reserved a large page file, PulseGuard now records an informational Virtual Memory finding with allocated/current/peak usage and explains that Windows may resize it after updates or memory-pressure changes. Automatic management is not overridden.

sections.heading: Paused and hidden Windows Update choices remain respected
sections.detail: PulseGuard continues to report Windows quality/feature pause state and hidden update counts. It does not defeat a deliberate pause or unhide updates through unsupported policy/registry changes.
